ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when value of status is not changed from "Validated" and "New" to "Assigned" .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISCHANGED( Status ) ,NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Validated") , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "New") )), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Assigned") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assigned can be changed from Validated and New.
